name: Kimi no Omoi
source:
Yotsuba and her childhood boyfriend Shinichi have mutual feelings, but it's another man who introduces her to the delights of physical love. While the heroine makes her choices freely she's still the plaything of a man who has broken a better love. He doesn't care about anything but sex with her. Heartbreak abounds.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE107657.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
四叶和她的青梅竹马男友进一彼此心意相通，但却是另一个男人让她初次体验到了肉体欢愉。虽然女主角自由地做出选择，但她仍然是一个破坏了美好恋情的男人的玩物。除了和她上床，他什么都不在乎。心碎无处不在。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE107657.html]DLsite English[/url]]
